The latest result shows net income at A$6,143 million with weaker earnings per share and higher credit impairment, which keeps asset quality and cost control firmly in focus.

The key short term catalyst is whether credit losses and expenses settle into something more predictable so the existing digital and business banking projects can show through in profit.
